picks.title: Why Healing My Internal World Changed Every Relationship in My External World — The Spiritual and Personal Growth That Showed Me How to Outgrow Old Patterns and Live a Life Full of Purpose and Passion
picks.summary: What if changing your relationships starts with changing what’s happening inside you?In this deeply personal episode of WE, Joe Mittiga shares how healing old emotional wounds transformed the way he experienced love, relationships, spirituality, and himself.
